title: Passive Aggressive
notes: Lamb Merguez Sausage: 500g Ground Lamb, 2 Garlic Cloves, 2 Tbsp Harissa, 1 tsp Cumin Seeds, 2 tsp Coriander Seeds, 2 tsp Fennel Seeds, 1 tsp Sweet Paprika, ¼ tsp Cayenne Pepper, ½ tsp Ground Cinnamon, 1 tsp Espelette Pepper, 2 Tbsp Preserved Lemon, Salt, Sausage Casing. Toast and grind the spices, finely chop the other ingredients and mix everything together well. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours then fill the casings using a sausage maker, or use in the recipe casing free.

ingredientSections.heading: Lamb and Squid
items: 450g Lamb Merguez Sausage (ask a good butcher or see note below)

ingredientSections.heading: Persillade
items: ¼ Cup Extra Virgin Olive Oil

ingredientSections.heading: Tomato Salpicon
items: ¼ Cup Extra Virgin Olive Oil

methodSections.heading: Lamb and Squid
steps: Clean and score the squid in a cross-hatch pattern and then cut into triangles.
In a frypan over a medium heat, sear the sausage until it is cooked to medium/medium well and then remove from pan.
In the same pan cook the squid for about 2 to 3 minutes until tender.

methodSections.heading: Persillade
steps: Finely chop the parsley, finely dice the garlic, and the combine all the ingredients in a bowl and set aside.

methodSections.heading: Whiskey Carrot Sauce
steps: Roughly chop the carrots, apples, celery and boil in the water with the salt in a medium sized saucepan until tender.
Place in a blender, including the liquid, and blend until smooth while adding the remaining ingredients. Strain through fine strainer, set aside.

methodSections.heading: Migas
steps: Combine all the ingredients, except the breadcrumbs, in a frypan over a medium heat.
When the garlic is toasted and the anchovies are rendered add the breadcrumbs and toast in the pan for 5 to 7 minutes. Stir regularly and monitor the heat so it doesn't burn.
Place on a tray and allow to cool.

methodSections.heading: Tomato Salpicon
steps: Roughly chop the tomatoes and finely chop the onion and chilli, removing the chilli seeds.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix together. Season and set aside.

methodSections.heading: Serving and Garnishes
steps: Plate in desired portions and garnish with watercress, shaved heirloom carrots and raw radishes.
